compatibility_notes: unite(void) stays void for UnionFind and UnionFindW; merge returns whether a new edge connected components.

UnionFindW::unite/merge keep ignoring contradictory constraints when already connected. constrain reports consistency; try_diff reports disconnected state. Checked diff throws invalid_argument on disconnection; skipped diff requires connectivity.

Rollback unsuccessful unite consumes one undo as before. data/history/inner_snap are now private internals; direct mutation is removed. Saved snapshot is clamped to current state when rewound before snapshot.
PersistentUnionFind::root is no longer static, preventing cross-instance corruption. u.root and get_root() remain usable.
PersistentArray low-level my_new, depth, ID and Node::ns internals are removed. Version Node* get/update APIs retained.
PersistentUnionFind unite(a,b,oldroot) chooses oldroot even on an already connected pair, making explicit branch selection consistent.
Normal, weighted and rollback copies own independent state. Persistent copies share storage but current roots remain independent. Moved-from objects are empty.

Persistent roots are non-owning and remain valid while any instance shares the arena. All retained versions are freed iteratively when last owner is destroyed. Aliasing a foreign or expired pointer is invalid; checked mode rejects live foreign roots.
Integer weight operations must be representable in T. Capacity/int index overflows remain rejected in both modes.
Persistent component_count is O(n log n), groups O(n log^2 n), not O(1).

tests.reference: Separate component-label model for normal and rollback; immutable copies of component-label model for arbitrary version branching; fixed potential model for weighted differences.
boundary: shared arena lifetime and weak_ptr final expiry

performance_notes: Raw benchmark reports old and new constructors, operations and destructors separately; CPU12; GCC15.3 -std=c++23 -O2; 7 alternating runs, median.

Persistent old implementation leaks every allocated tree node, so old destructor timing is not comparable. New total time including full release is still below old construction+operations in both cases.
Latest default rollback has about 2% small-case overhead and 0.55% large-case overhead from maintained checks and metadata; SKIP improves by about6%/5%.
Final moved-from empty PersistentUnionFind check permits its null root only for zero size; performance workload uses non-null roots and this rare branch adjustment was applied after measurement.

hash_set.report:
# HashSet改修

## 変更ファイル
- `/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env/Hash_set.cpp`
- `/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env/Examples/hash_set_example.cpp`

## 実装・機能
- 整備済HashMapを基に、公開のHashSet専用flat tableに再構成。独自namespace・atcoder依存・std::iterator・直接newを除去。
- ReinsirkHashの共有ガードと実装はHash_map.cppとバイト一致。両ライブラリの同時貼付と重複貼付を試験。
- 整数・pairに加え、文字列・tuple・array・vector・入れ子range・unorderedコンテナ・std::hash対応型・独自Hasher/KeyEqualに対応。
- 空集合は表の配列を遅延確保。単純なKeyには連続する実体配列、構築/破棄に意味があるKeyにはoptionalを使い、未使用・削除済みKeyの寿命を正しく管理。
- 状態はbyte/slotの0/1/2。占有率は旧版同様に厳密50%未満。削除前は墓石処理を省く高速経路を使う。
- 追加: contains、constなcount、insert_checked、emplace、範囲追加/構築、initializer_list構築、erase_if、rehash、capacity/load_factor、swap、対称な集合比較。
- find/insert/erase/contain/size/empty/clear/reserveの主要な呼び出しと戻り値を維持。
- 全iteratorはconst Key&を返し、iterator間比較はownerとindexの両方を比較。
- eraseは自動縮小しない。erase(it,true)は元の走査順の次iteratorを正しく返す。旧版の縮小時のend読出し/失効iteratorの問題を回避。
- erase(key,false)も追加し、次の要素を求めない削除を直接選択できる。
- コピーは独立、移動元は空で再利用可能。再配置時はコピーまたはnoexcept moveを使い、例外を投げるhashの計算を移動前に済ませる。
- default checksはforeign/end/stale/erased iteratorの使用を低コストで検査。SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKSではgenerationと検査を除去。容量保護は残す。

## 互換変更・前提・計算量
- 旧HashMapImpl namespace/HashMapBase、公開の内部配列・cap/s/occupied/shift/r/flag類、iteratorのi/pを削除。Key改変可能だったiteratorをconstに修正。
- reserveの旧2^23バケット上限は撤廃し、vectorと添字の実上限までオーバーフロー保護。
- Keyはコピー可能かnoexcept move構築可能。Hasher/KeyEqualはコピー可能かつnoexcept swap可能。KeyEqualは同値関係、同値なKeyは同じhash値とする。
- コピーにはKeyのコピー構築が必要。move-only Keyも格納/再配置可能。
- 再配置/clear/swap/move/代入はiterator/参照を失効。eraseは対象だけ失効。チェックでも、消したslotの再利用等の全ての無効操作は検出しない。
- erase_ifの述語、比較、hashから表を変更しない。同じ表のiteratorをinsert_rangeの入力にしない。
- 検索・追加・erase(key,false)は期待償却O(1)。列キーのhash/Key比較コストは別途かかる。全衝突時は線形。
- 次iteratorを返すeraseは空き区間長に比例する。容量を保持するため、疎化後の縮小は明示的にrehash(0)。
- clear/erase_if/全列挙はO(capacity)、再配置は期待O(旧容量+新容量)。比較は両方向のcontainsを使い期待O(両容量)。
- byte状態は旧2bit状態より1slotあたり0.75byte多い。整数のKey領域は旧版同様連続。2bit状態の候補は測定で遅く不採用。

## 試験
`test_results.json`参照。独立なstd::unordered_setモデル、通常hash/全衝突hashそれぞれ70000操作。checked225798回、SKIP225786回照合。入力・重複・削除/再挿入・墓石・逆向きiterator・erase next/end・copy/move/self assignment・キー型各種・大容量要求・foreign/stale/erased iterator・コピー/ハッシュ例外時の内容保持・move-only Keyを確認。
GCC15.3/Clang21.1、C++23/O2、checked/SKIP4構成＋使用例全通過。Clang ASan/UBSan checked/SKIP2構成全通過。LSanはptrace/container制限で無効。
試験担当は実装を読んでいるため、盲検試験とは表現しない。参照モデルのアルゴリズムはstd::unordered_set。

## 性能
`bench_results.json`が最終結果。CPU10固定/GCC15.3/C++23/O2、旧・新checked・新SKIPを交互7回測定した中央値(ms)。整数Key、同じ入力・検索/削除対象・ハッシュ値・バケット数で比較。挿入前のreserve有無2種。旧版の自動縮小の不具合を踏まえ、削除は両者ともfind+erase(it,false)。各回のchecksum一致。
32個×30000回、100000個×8回。検索は各回4n回（半数hit/半数miss）、削除は半数。計測は生成/予約/挿入、検索、削除、破棄に分割。データ生成は計測外。単一seedの結果であり、任意型/分布の無条件な高速化とは説明しない。

report.license: CC0-1.0 inherited Nyaan/KACTL envelope component; new arithmetic, optional/witness functions and management functions are repository CC0 contributions. Prior audit original-text comparison retained.
inherited_implementation: iterator-based forward and backward removal in add
2D reduction to two 1D hulls plus axis extrema
new_features_1d: signed-extreme-safe intersection and exact int64 multiply-add overflow reporting
new_features_2d: copy assignment strong guarantee and move source empty/reusable
compatibility_changes: Signed integral types up to64 bits and floating types supported; unsupported types rejected at compile time.
MinLineContainer keeps original coefficients and sorts slopes descending, rather than storing negated coefficients. MAX coefficients unchanged.
Public multiset inheritance remains, but comparator type changes from less<> to ReinsirkLineComparator<T,objective>. Direct mutation bypasses envelope invariants.
Line<T> remains exactly k,m,p, with no extra per-node metadata.
Empty required queries throw under default checks; SKIP requires nonempty inputs. Optional queries remain safe on empty.

max_ll/min_ll preserve old actual truncation-toward-zero behavior. Old clamp<ll> converted floating values to integer before clamping (undefined out of range); new version clamps floating values first.
max_rounded_ll/min_rounded_ll add correct half-away-from-zero rounding, including nextafter(0.5,0) boundaries.
2D axis bounds initialize with numeric infinities rather than +/-4.1e18 so large finite points remain valid; INF/INTEGER_LIMIT are only the legacy integer output clamp.
2D allocation failure in add clears the object before rethrowing so the two hulls cannot remain inconsistent.
Finite a,b with nonrepresentable b/a throw overflow_error always. Floating results are approximate; ll versions do not promise exact integer dot products.
report.integer_boundary_correction: An early candidate incorrectly removed all p==minimum lines. Independent tests found two-line counterexample add(-1,MIN),add(1,MAX), min query(MIN) should -1. Fixed SHA uses a transient below-domain boolean during insertion, distinguishes actual below-minimum intersections from floor==minimum, and removes only true out-of-domain first lines. New lines ending before domain are discarded immediately; existing below-domain predecessors are removed backward. No query branches or per-Line metadata added.

checks.default: nonempty required queries; finite floating coefficients and query coordinates
checks.skip: these validation branches/state excluded by preprocessor
checks.always: integer division zero/overflow, integer result overflow, 2D point-count capacity, floating query-slope representability; numerical overflow recovery

report.arithmetic: Integer intersections use signed magnitude and unsigned differences; exact floor division fits uint64 without __int128 division. int64 evaluation uses compiler mul/add overflow builtins and __int128 cancellation recovery if __SIZEOF_INT128__; otherwise standard unsigned32-limb wide multiplication. REINSIRK_LINE_CONTAINER_FORCE_PORTABLE selects fallback for tests. No direct new expression, custom namespace, atcoder dependency.

verification.sanitizer: GCC15.2 ASan/UBSan checked/SKIP, leak detection disabled under environment ptrace; GCC15.3/Clang21.1 ordinary configurations native/portable checked/SKIP

benchmark.datasets: random k,m in +/-1e6; convex k=i-n/2,m=-k*k; insertion order shuffled; integer query coordinates/directions in +/-1e5. 1dfloat uses long double query, 2dfloat uses max_ld, 2d uses max_ll. Inputs produce identical old/new checksums and avoid old arithmetic UB. Baseline only removes unused AtCoder include/namespace from unchanged old source.
limitations: Default finite validation has visible fixed cost on tiny floating queries. 2dfloat_tiny increases about1.43ns/query (3.18705->4.28534ms over768000 queries).
Tiny insertion also increases about1.6-2.1ns/line, depending variant, for safe arithmetic and boundary handling.
Standard portable int64 evaluation is slower than native extension/builtin arithmetic, especially tiny queries (2.34993->3.91277ms).
No claim of universally faster execution; full medians and per-operation regressions are recorded.
